Your holdings: SOXL (-47.34%) and SPAL (-45.29%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, decaying, and on margin, these drawdowns hurt extra. SMH is also down (-9.77%) but has a scanner signal.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader market's "crash-up" momentum for signs of a pullback. Also, watch for any further news on chip sector capital raises after Intel's announcement.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage your leveraged, losing positions; they're amplifying risk in a volatile market.
plays: Seriously consider trimming or cutting SOXL and SPAL. Their deep losses and leveraged nature on margin are amplifying risk significantly.
SMH is down -9.77% and has a scanner long setup. If you're looking to add to chip exposure, consider an entry at 573.81-573.23 with a stop at 571.59.
No other compelling new buys today; hold current positions and watch market dynamics.
